notes: Repository and branch are read from what the editor already puts in its own window title. This connector never touches the filesystem and never reads file contents - a tool that opened your working tree to learn about your work would be the thing this product exists to avoid.

fields.name: repo
fields.description: Repository or workspace name as the editor titles it.

fields.name: branch
fields.description: Branch name when the title or status bar exposes one.

fields.name: active_file
fields.description: Relative file name only. Never the path, never the contents.

fields.name: dirty_files
fields.description: Count of changed files when the surface exposes one. A number, never a list.
